title: Direct Bandgap Light Emission from Strained Germanium Nanowires Coupled with High-Q Nanophotonic Cavities
notes: Spine: need -> hypothesis -> GOI stack / nanowire+DBR architecture / strain sweep -> litho+etch -> KOH undercut -> ~2.4% strain (FEM+Raman) -> gap narrowing (red-shift) -> strain-Gamma pathway -> brighter direct-gap PL -> net gain improves with strain; free-carrier tradeoff -> net gain negative, falls with pump -> no lasing -> conclusion. Second branch: fabricated cavity shape -> Q~2000. Side: capillary reattachment -> SiO2 contact -> >10x pump tolerance (argued; SI thermal sims not in packet); valence-band loss partition (computed F5c) counteracts; design guidance; comparison with Ge lasing reports. Audits: o8 Raman pad strain above FEM (text_silent), o11 2.37% emission truncated by detector limit, L1 circular carrier-density axis. Not in graph: ALD Al2O3 passivation step (text only), FSR discrepancy (image_note o13), F1b stack and F2d schematic (opened, not used as evidence). No multi-cause claims.
